page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6e.26xlarge is a dedicated x86_64 cloud server running on KVM virtualization. It is provisioned with 104 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 3.69 GB of memory per processing core. The instance is equipped with a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth connection and contains no discrete GPU hardware.

The server profile omits local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent data requirements. The configuration emphasizes massive core density combined with high baseline networking capacity, making it dependent on remote storage interfaces for disk IOPS.

The ecs.ebmg6e.26xlarge is designed for multi-threaded enterprise applications, batch execution jobs, high-concurrency microservice clusters, and parallelized CPU computational tasks that require substantial core allocation without specialized GPU acceleration or dedicated onboard storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6e.26xlarge is a high-density general-purpose cloud instance configured with 104 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding roughly 3.69 GB of system memory per vCPU core. Running on KVM virtualization, it provides a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth to facilitate high-throughput network data transfers. The instance does not feature local block storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on remote block storage solutions for persistent data needs. Its hardware configuration offers significant multi-core processing capability, making it well-suited for compute-heavy parallel tasks, enterprise application servers, large microservice clusters, and batch execution pipelines that demand high core density without requiring dedicated local disk drives or dedicated graphical processing hardware.
